name: Chaophraya
description: Star of 5,400 K, 185 parsecs away, with 1 transiting planet.

text.card: WASP-50 b crosses Chaophraya as seen from Earth, which is how it was found.
text.introduction: Its radius and temperature follow Chakrabarty & Sengupta 2019.

quotes.title: WASP-50
quotes.card: WASP-50, also named Chaophraya, is a G-type main-sequence star about 594 light-years away in the constellation Eridanus.
quotes.introduction: The star is older than the Sun and slightly depleted in heavy elements compared to the Sun, and has a close to average starspot activity.
